x: To field a team of 10 and NOT turn out Thresher, Whewell, Fairclough, O'Hara and Steer and still finish fourth behind Coventry, Tipton, and Derby was no mean achievement and answered well for our own relay two weeks later.
The team that eventually took part was but a shadow of our full strength with names such as Fairclough, Hart, O'Hara, Steer, Thresher and Whewell missing from the line up.
The first of the four laps saw Thresher forcing an exceptionally fast pace and at 2 miles he was 30 yds clear of O'Hara, Piotrowski, Hart and Whewell who were also well clear of the field.
